correctness.rationale: For fixed b,r>=2 with n=bN labelled worlds and every equivalence class of each independent uniform partition of size b, the C=U operation identity is exactly connectedness of the join relation. A given bj-subset is saturated by a partition with probability binom(N,j)/binom(bN,bj), yielding Q_j=binom(N,j)^r/binom(bN,bj)^(r-1). The j>=2 sum has uniform fixed-parameter O(N^(-2 gamma)) bound from fixed-index binomial comparison and entropy control for large j. The expected number of common b-blocks is mu=N^r/binom(bN,b)^(r-1); the second factorial moment is O(N^(-2gamma)), giving a sharp Bonferroni sandwich and conditional unique isolated b-component. Rooted-component decomposition gives the exact connected-tuple recurrence. The matching boundary b=r=2 counts one alternating cycle: connected count 2^(N-1)(N-1)! per fixed first matching, giving exact 2^(2N-1)/(N binom(2N,N)) probability. Independently enumerated all tuples of pairings for (N,r)=(2,3),(3,2),(3,3),(4,2) and obtained connected counts 24/27,120/225,3000/3375,5040/11025. Finite counts do not prove asymptotics.
